about_the_game:
Misaki Tetsumora is a well renowned judge who resides in the supernatural town of Kazemori. Where criminals of all kinds run amok.

Humans, ghosts, thieves, serial killers, zombies, speeding ticket violators and demonic jerks to name a few. It's your job to help her choose the final verdict on each one of the criminals that come into her courtroom.

But, be careful. Each choice comes with a different moral alignment. The judge is sexy, the criminals are nasty and the jury is just a talking skeleton who loves handing out guilty verdicts like candy on Halloween.

By the end of the day, what kind of judge will you become? 

Time will tell in "The Judge". The final verdict is...

*Warning: This game may contain content that some viewers may find disturbing, offensive and cruel. Such as humiliation, verbal mention of sexual assault and death, etc.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature topics and content that some players may find disturbing or are sensitive to, such as the discussion of sexual assault, deciding the extent of punishments i.e. death or humiliation, etc.
